create_vectorizer_tfidf: create a TfidfVectorizer to extract tf-idf features from a corpus of text documents
build_nmf_topics: build an NMF model to extract topic structure from a tf-idf document matrix
build_lda_topics: build a LatentDirichletAllocation model to extract topics from a term-frequency document matrix
create_vectorizer_count: create a CountVectorizer to extract raw term-count features from a corpus of text documents
build_minibatch_nmf: build a MiniBatchNMF model to extract topics from a tf-idf document matrix using mini-batch training
